general.notes: Supply +3.3V single supply. Case temperature TC –40°C to +95°C; electrical/optical specs guaranteed over recommended case operating temperature. Signaling rate 125 Mbaud (Fast Ethernet 4B/5B); Ethernet auto-negotiation pulses not supported. RX input optical power (PIN –31 to –14 dBm) at BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹⁰ with 62.5/125 µm NA=0.275 or 50/125 µm NA=0.20; crosstalk from TX simulated. TX output power ranges differ by fiber: 62.5/125 µm NA=0.275 (–20 to –14 dBm) vs 50/125 µm NA=0.20 (–23.5 to –14 dBm); average power; +3 dB for peak. Center wavelength λC 1270–1380 nm (typ 1308 nm). Transmitter/receiver power dissipation (PDISS) listed separately for TX and RX, not as single module total. Storage temperature –40°C to +100°C (absolute max, not operating). LED aging typically <1 dB over commercial life (1310-nm LEDs, narrative only).
